note: Three hop merchants' own published variety specifications, transcribed field for field so that every number in data/hops can be checked against the document it cites. Nothing here is this project's opinion: a figure appears exactly as its publisher prints it, including single values where a merchant publishes one, and ceilings where a merchant prints '<1'. Where a publisher prints something that cannot be true, the field is refused and the reason recorded rather than repaired — see the Charles Faram entry. app/validate-hops.mjs fails the build when a hop record disagrees with the sheet it cites, which is how the eighty-one records that used to disagree can never quietly come back.
shape: Each field is one of {value}, {min,max}, {max,atMost:true} for a '<n' ceiling, or {min,atLeast:true} for a '>n' floor. A field the publisher does not print is absent.

haas-companion-2022.title: Hops Companion (2022)
haas-companion-2022.kind: merchant variety guide, freely distributed PDF
haas-companion-2022.read: Parsed from the PDF by page geometry — each label paired with the value printed on the same line — rather than by text order. Text order silently mis-pairs: pdfminer emits 'Total Polyphenols' after the first nine values on some pages, which slides every field by one, and an earlier text-order parse read Simcoe as 4.5-8.0% alpha where the page plainly prints 12.0-15.5%. Geometry pairing resolves all 166 variety pages with no unpaired field; twenty pages were then read by eye and agree with the parser field for field. Page numbers below are zero-based PDF pages, not the printed folio.

rahrbsg-variety-sheets.title: Per-variety hop product sheets
rahrbsg-variety-sheets.kind: merchant product sheets, one PDF per variety
rahrbsg-variety-sheets.read: Each sheet is keyed by its filename, not by the heading printed on the page: Idaho 7's sheet leads with the sensory word 'CITRUS', and a spec table filed under the wrong variety is precisely the failure this whole exercise exists to catch. Every other sheet's printed heading was checked against its filename and agrees.

charles-faram-hop-oracle.title: Hop Oracle variety pages
charles-faram-hop-oracle.read: The only merchant found that publishes Northdown, Jester, Olicana and Harlequin. Its alpha, beta and cohumulone agree with Haas and RahrBSG wherever all three carry a variety — Cascade's cohumulone is 33-40 on all three. Two of its fields are not usable and are refused rather than corrected: total oil is printed with a stray digit on many pages (Challenger '10.0-10.5 ml/100g', Northdown '10.2-20.2', Endeavour '10.1-10.7'), and myrcene is sometimes a fraction and sometimes a percentage on the same page (Cascade '0.53' where every other merchant prints 45-60%). The obvious repair in both cases is to shift a decimal point, which is exactly why this does not do it — a number this project invented is worse than a number it does not have.
refusalRules: total oil outside 0.3-6.0 mL/100 g is refused as a printing error
an oil fraction below 1 is refused as a fraction the publisher did not label as one
a non-numeric value such as 'Trace%' is refused
charles-faram-hop-oracle.urlNote: There is no index page at /hop-oracle/ — it 404s. Each variety has its own page and every variety used here carries its own URL below; this is one of them, so the source line points at a document rather than a directory that does not exist.

nzhops-product-pages.title: Variety product pages
nzhops-product-pages.kind: grower co-operative product pages, server-rendered HTML
nzhops-product-pages.read: Used for one variety only. NZ Hops publishes a per-variety PDF sheet, but the Nectaron sheet is an image with no text layer, so nothing can be read out of it and it is not cited as though it were. The product page itself states the alpha range in its own copy — '(10-14% AA)' — and that is the only figure taken. Beta and oil are not published anywhere retrievable for this variety, so they are absent rather than estimated.
